summary: AEVEX Corp. filed an 8-K to report entry into a new credit agreement with Bank of America as agent. The facility consists of $375M in senior secured facilities ($100M term loan, $75M delayed-draw term loan, $200M revolver) taken out in connection with its recent IPO. No special-situation M&A, activist, restructuring, or return of capital is present; this is a routine financing arrangement linked to an IPO closing. The filing discloses covenants and guarantees but does not involve a corporate event requiring special-situations classification.
